Please solve this issue: We're building backend for a helpdesk SaaS for businesses and their customers.
Use Rails in API-only mode; the frontend is a separate app.
Ruby, Rails, Puma, and PostgreSQL are installed. If you need anything else, install it yourself.
Use `DATABASE_URL`. Work in `/app`.

The inbox is getting busy. Let staff mark tickets `normal` or `high` priority; default to normal.
Add priority to the existing ticket responses and updates, and let staff combine filters:

```http
GET /api/v1/tickets?status=open&assignee_id=unassigned&priority=high&q=receipt
```

Support status, assignee, requester, and priority filters, plus `q` for a case-insensitive search
through subjects and public comments. Use `assignee_id` and `requester_id` for people; `unassigned`
means nobody is assigned. Search should treat what the user types as literal text.
Customers can filter their own requests by status. Priority is internal.

## Recommended Workflow

This workflow should be done step-by-step so that you can iterate on your changes and any possible problems.

1. Analyze the codebase by finding and reading relevant files
2. Create a script to reproduce the issue
3. Edit the source code to resolve the issue
4. Verify your fix works by running your script again
5. Test edge cases to ensure your fix is robust
6. Submit your changes and finish your work by issuing the following command: `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT`.
   Do not combine it with any other command. <important>After this command, you cannot continue working on this task.</important>

## Command Execution Rules

You are operating in an environment where

1. You issue at least one command
2. The system executes the command(s) in a subshell
3. You see the result(s)
4. You write your next command(s)

Each response should include:

1. **Reasoning text** where you explain your analysis and plan
2. At least one tool call with your command

**CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

- Your response SHOULD include reasoning text explaining what you're doing
- Your response MUST include AT LEAST ONE bash tool call
- Directory or environment variable changes are not persistent. Every action is executed in a new subshell.
- However, you can prefix any action with `MY_ENV_VAR=MY_VALUE cd /path/to/working/dir && ...` or write/load environment variables from files
- Submit your changes and finish your work by issuing the following command: `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT`.

Here's my take on the code-reading process:

**Diving into the Codebase**

Okay, time to get a good grip on this project. From what I can see, it looks pretty tidy, which is always a good sign. Let's start by doing a thorough review of the code; I'm going to start with the essentials. I want to build a conceptual map of the project, so I'll start with the foundational files: `Gemfile`, `README`, `config/routes.rb` – those should give me a solid overview of the dependencies, purpose, and web service structure. Then, I'll move into the database setup with `config/database.yml`, and `db/schema.rb`, and of course the migrations in `db/migrate/*` to understand how the database evolves over time. I'll need to know the models, so `app/models/*` are crucial, and the controllers `app/controllers/**/*` will flesh out how the app handles requests and delivers responses. Finally, of course, I'll need to look at the test suite to see how the software is validated! This methodical approach should give me a complete overview.

  assert_equal "solved", response.parsed_body.dig("request", "status")

  patch "/api/v1/tickets/#{first_id}",
    params: { ticket: { comment: { body: "Secondary admin reply" }, status: "open" } },
    headers: account_headers("edgeco", second_admin_token),
    as: :json
  assert_response :ok
  assert_equal "open", response.parsed_body.dig("ticket", "status")

  # Now first_id is most recently active on both /tickets and /requests
  get "/api/v1/tickets", headers: account_headers("edgeco", second_admin_token)
  assert_equal [ first_id, second_id ], response.parsed_body["tickets"].map { |t| t["id"] }

  get "/api/v1/requests", headers: account_headers("edgeco", avery_token)
  assert_equal [ first_id, second_id ], response.parsed_body["requests"].map { |r| r["id"] }

  # Customer comment forced public: true; staff private comment hidden from customer
  patch "/api/v1/tickets/#{first_id}",
    params: { ticket: { comment: { body: "Internal staff note", public: false } } },
    headers: account_headers("edgeco", owner_token),
    as: :json
  assert_response :ok

  get "/api/v1/tickets/#{first_id}/comments", headers: account_headers("edgeco", owner_token)
  assert_equal 3, response.parsed_body["count"]
  assert_equal [ true, true, false ], response.parsed_body["comments"].map { |c| c["public"] }

  get "/api/v1/requests/#{first_id}/comments", headers: account_headers("edgeco", avery_token)
  assert_equal 2, response.parsed_body["count"]
  assert_equal [ true, true ], response.parsed_body["comments"].map { |c| c["public"] }

  # Boundary pagination (count == per_page == 2), out-of-range page, and malformed pagination params
  get "/api/v1/tickets", params: { page: 1, per_page: 2 }, headers: account_headers("edgeco", owner_token)

  assert_nil response.parsed_body["next_page"]
  assert_equal 1, response.parsed_body["previous_page"]

  get "/api/v1/tickets", params: { page: 0, per_page: -5 }, headers: account_headers("edgeco", owner_token)
  assert_response :ok
  assert_equal 1, response.parsed_body["page"]
  assert_equal 25, response.parsed_body["per_page"]

  get "/api/v1/tickets", params: { "page[]" => 1 }, headers: account_headers("edgeco", owner_token)
  assert_response :ok

  # Non-numeric IDs return 404
  get "/api/v1/tickets/not-an-id", headers: account_headers("edgeco", owner_token)
  assert_response :not_found
  get "/api/v1/requests/not-an-id", headers: account_headers("edgeco", avery_token)
  assert_response :not_found

  # Unknown keys only in PATCH return 422
  patch "/api/v1/tickets/#{first_id}", params: { ticket: { unknown: 1 } }, headers: account_headers("edgeco", owner_token), as: :json
  assert_response :unprocessable_entity
  patch "/api/v1/requests/#{first_id}", params: { request: { unknown: 1 } }, headers: account_headers("edgeco", avery_token), as: :json
  assert_response :unprocessable_entity

  # Cancel and reactivate preserves all tickets and comments
  post "/api/v1/account/cancel", headers: account_headers("edgeco", owner_token), as: :json
  assert_response :ok

  post "/api/v1/sessions",
    params: { session: { email: "jo@edgeco.test", password: "owner-password" } },
    headers: account_headers("edgeco"),
    as: :json
  recovery_token = response.parsed_body.dig("session", "token")

  post "/api/v1/account/reactivate", headers: account_headers("edgeco", recovery_token), as: :json
  assert_response :ok

  get "/api/v1/tickets", headers: account_headers("edgeco", recovery_token)
  assert_response :ok
  assert_equal 2, response.parsed_body["count"]
end

require "test_helper"

class EdgeCasesTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  test "CORS headers are included on actual API responses for allowed origin" do
    with_env("HELPDESK_FRONTEND_URL" => "http://localhost:3001") do
      post "/api/v1/account/create",
        params: {
          account: {
            name: "CorsCo",
            subdomain: "corsco",
            admin: { name: "Jo", email: "jo@corsco.test", password: "my-first-password" }
          }
        },
        headers: { "Origin" => "http://localhost:3001" },
        as: :json

      assert_response :created
      assert_equal "http://localhost:3001", response.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"]

      get "/api/v1/portal",
        headers: {
          "Origin" => "http://localhost:3001",
          "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "corsco"
        }
      assert_response :ok
      assert_equal "http://localhost:3001", response.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"]
    end
  end

  test "malformed JSON returns 400 Bad Request with JSON content type" do
    post "/api/v1/account/create",
      params: "{malformed-json",
      headers: { "Content-Type" => "application/json", "Accept" => "application/json" }

    assert_response :bad_request
    assert_includes response.media_type, "application/json"
  end

  test "expired verification and password reset tokens are rejected" do
    post "/api/v1/account/create",
      params: {
        account: {
          name: "ExpireTokenCo",
          subdomain: "expiretokenco",
          admin: { name: "Jo", email: "jo@expire.test", password: "my-first-password" }
        }
      },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    v_token = ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last.body.decoded[/token=([A-Za-z0-9]+)/, 1]

    travel 25.hours do
      post "/api/v1/email_verifications/confirm",
        params: { email_verification: { token: v_token } },
        headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "expiretokenco" },
        as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_entity
    end

    # Requesting a fresh link works
    post "/api/v1/email_verifications",
      params: { email_verification: { email: "jo@expire.test" } },
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "expiretokenco" },
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok
    fresh_v_token = ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last.body.decoded[/token=([A-Za-z0-9]+)/, 1]

    post "/api/v1/email_verifications/confirm",
      params: { email_verification: { token: fresh_v_token } },
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "expiretokenco" },
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok

    # Password reset expiration (> 2 hours)
    post "/api/v1/password_resets",
      params: { password_reset: { email: "jo@expire.test" } },
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "expiretokenco" },
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok
    r_token = ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last.body.decoded[/token=([A-Za-z0-9]+)/, 1]

        headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "expiretokenco" },
        as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  test "unknown api/v1 route returns 404 JSON" do
    get "/api/v1/nonexistent"
    assert_response :not_found
    assert_equal "Not found", response.parsed_body["error"]
  end
end

require "test_helper"

class EdgeCasesTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  test "CORS headers are included on actual API responses for allowed origin" do
    with_env("HELPDESK_FRONTEND_URL" => "http://localhost:3001") do
      post "/api/v1/account/create",
        params: {
          account: {
            name: "CorsCo",
            subdomain: "corsco",
            admin: { name: "Jo", email: "jo@corsco.test", password: "my-first-password" }
          }
        },
        headers: { "Origin" => "http://localhost:3001" },
        as: :json

      assert_response :created
      assert_equal "http://localhost:3001", response.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"]

      get "/api/v1/portal",
        headers: {
          "Origin" => "http://localhost:3001",
          "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "corsco"
        }
      assert_response :ok
      assert_equal "http://localhost:3001", response.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"]
    end
  end

  test "malformed JSON returns 400 Bad Request with JSON content type" do
    post "/api/v1/account/create",
      params: "{malformed-json",
      headers: { "Content-Type" => "application/json", "Accept" => "application/json" }

    assert_response :bad_request
    assert_includes response.media_type, "application/json"
  end

  test "expired verification and password reset tokens are rejected" do
    post "/api/v1/account/create",
      params: {
        account: {
          name: "ExpireTokenCo",
          subdomain: "expiretokenco",
          admin: { name: "Jo", email: "jo@expire.test", password: "my-first-password" }
        }
      },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    v_token = ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last.body.decoded[/token=([A-Za-z0-9]+)/, 1]

    travel 25.hours do
      post "/api/v1/email_verifications/confirm",
        params: { email_verification: { token: v_token } },
        headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "expiretokenco" },
        as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_entity
    end

    # Requesting a fresh link works
    post "/api/v1/email_verifications",
      params: { email_verification: { email: "jo@expire.test" } },
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "expiretokenco" },
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok
    fresh_v_token = ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last.body.decoded[/token=([A-Za-z0-9]+)/, 1]

    post "/api/v1/email_verifications/confirm",
      params: { email_verification: { token: fresh_v_token } },
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "expiretokenco" },
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok

    # Password reset expiration (> 2 hours)
    post "/api/v1/password_resets",
      params: { password_reset: { email: "jo@expire.test" } },
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "expiretokenco" },

        params: { password_reset: { token: r_token, password: "new-password" } },
        headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "expiretokenco" },
        as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  test "unknown api/v1 route returns 404 JSON" do
    get "/api/v1/nonexistent"
    assert_response :not_found
    assert_equal "Not found", response.parsed_body["error"]
  end
end

**Detailed Analysis of Ticket Filtering & Search**

Okay, let's break this down. First, I need to ensure the existing validation and update logic for `Ticket` statuses and priorities is robust. The existing system in `Ticket` model uses `STATUSES` and `PRIORITIES` constants with inclusion validation, which is good.  In the `TicketsController#update`, the priority update logic checks the input `raw_priority` to be a String. If the priority isn't a valid value according to the validation rules it returns a 422 error, which is the expected atomic behavior.

Now, let's dig into the new filtering and search requirements. The core of this is the request for adding priority filtering to the staff tickets endpoint, including support for combined filters such as status, assignee, requester, priority, and free text search using the `q` parameter.  This will affect both staff (`GET /api/v1/tickets`) and customer (`GET /api/v1/requests`) endpoints, however, I will focus on the staff side first.

The current `GET /api/v1/tickets` endpoint uses `recent_activity` for ordering and pagination. I need to make sure filtering and searching do not interfere with ordering or pagination. Specifically, the pagination logic needs to handle duplicate ticket counts correctly when searching through comments. I recall this is a potential issue, especially when dealing with joins. The SQL technique to solve this is to use `EXISTS` to avoid row multiplication and ensure the count and offset are accurate. That pattern is the classic SQL best practice.

Now, let's analyze each filter parameter. I should follow the existing pattern in the codebase. I see that `InvitationsController#index` and `UsersController#index` check for the presence and validity of filter parameters. For instance, the `status` parameter is checked for inclusion in `Invitation::STATUSES` and returns a 422 if invalid. This pattern needs to be applied to the `status` and `priority` filters. But, I should analyze the edge cases of blank or missing filter params.
When params are not included (missing query param in the URL), like `?status=` or even `?status=`, these controller examples treat them as not filtering (no-op). **Deep Dive on Ticket Filter Parameters**

Okay, this codebase is incredibly well-structured, a real pleasure to work with. Let's dig into these filter parameters one by one, ensuring we consider all edge cases and security implications.

First, the `status` filter. Valid values are clearly defined, and the code handles empty or whitespace values correctly by ignoring the filter.  The error handling for invalid statuses is consistent and, importantly, matches existing patterns in other controllers, which is great for maintainability.  We’re already seeing that this is well-tested: the 422 responses in this case are important for API consistency.

Next, `priority`. This is where it gets interesting.  Since customers have no business filtering by priority, we need to think about *how* to prevent them from doing it. The existing pattern here is crucial: unknown query parameters are simply ignored.  This is a good, secure default, and prevents information leakage.  It also maintains consistency with similar controllers across the system. Double checking the documentation, we see this is intentional: priority is *internal* to the staff.

The `assignee_id` parameter calls for a deep dive.  We have to handle "unassigned", numeric IDs, and invalid input strings very carefully.  The "unassigned" case seems straightforward, mapping to a `nil` `assignee_id` in the database. When it comes to numeric IDs, it is essential to consider the implications of non-existent IDs, IDs from other accounts, suspended staff, and even customers or admins, since the documentation tells us that `assignee_id` should be used for *staff* users. A malformed integer like `abc` should return a 422 Unprocessable Entity - thankfully this is confirmed by existing tests.

Now, should we return 200 OK with an empty list or a 422?  This is the million-dollar question for the numeric IDs.  Returning 200 with an empty list would be RESTful, because the ID *could* exist, and is correctly scoped by the tenant's account. This avoids any information leak from cross-account lookups (which must be prevented). This feels correct, let's explore this further.

    class AccountsController < BaseController
      before_action :require_account!, only: %i[show cancel reactivate]

      def create
        account_attrs = require_hash_param(:account)
        admin_attrs = account_attrs[:admin]

        unless admin_attrs.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters) || admin_attrs.is_a?(Hash)
          return render json: {
            error: "Admin can't be blank",
            errors: { admin: [ "can't be blank" ] }
          }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        account = Account.new(
          name: account_attrs[:name],
          subdomain: account_attrs[:subdomain]

        user = User.new(
          account: account,
          name: admin_attrs[:name],

          role: "admin",

        )

        account_valid = account.valid?

          return render json: {

          }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        verification_token = nil
        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do

          user.save!

      before_action :authenticate_user!, only: %i[destroy]

      def create
        session_params = require_hash_param(:session)
        email = session_params[:email].to_s.strip.downcase
        password = session_params[:password].to_s

        user = current_account.users.find_by(email: email)

        if user.nil? || password.empty? || !user.authenticate(password)
          return render json: { error: "Invalid email or password" }, status: :unauthorized
        end

        unless user.verified?
          return render json: { error: "Email address must be verified before signing in" }, status: :forbidden
        end

        if user.suspended?
          return render json: { error: "User account is suspended" }, status: :forbidden
        end

        if current_account.cancelled?
          if current_account.cancellation_expired?
            return render json: { error: "Account cancellation period has expired" }, status: :forbidden
          elsif !user.owner?
            return render json: { error: "Account is cancelled" }, status: :forbidden
          end
        end

        session = current_account.sessions.create!(user: user)

        render json: {
          session: session.api_json,
          user: user.api_json,
          account: current_account.api_json
        }, status: :created
      end

        current_session.destroy!

    class RegistrationsController < BaseController

      before_action :ensure_account_active!

        user_params = require_hash_param(:user).permit(:name, :email, :password)

        user = current_account.users.new(
          name: user_params[:name],
          email: user_params[:email],
          password: user_params[:password],
          role: "customer",
          verified: false
        )

        verification_token = nil
        current_account.with_lock do
          if user.email.present? && current_account.invitations.pending.exists?(email: user.email)
            user.valid?
            user.errors.add(:email, "has already been invited")
            return render_validation_errors(user)
          end

          user.save!
          verification_token = user.issue_email_verification_token!
        end

        UserMailer.email_verification(user: user, token: verification_token.token).deliver_now

        render json: { user: user.api_json }, status: :created

      before_action :authenticate_user!, only: %i[destroy]

      def create
        session_params = require_hash_param(:session)
        email = session_params[:email].to_s.strip.downcase
        password = session_params[:password].to_s

        user = current_account.users.find_by(email: email)

        if user.nil? || password.empty? || !user.authenticate(password)
          return render json: { error: "Invalid email or password" }, status: :unauthorized
        end

        unless user.verified?
          return render json: { error: "Email address must be verified before signing in" }, status: :forbidden
        end

        if user.suspended?
          return render json: { error: "User account is suspended" }, status: :forbidden
        end

        if current_account.cancelled?
          if current_account.cancellation_expired?
            return render json: { error: "Account cancellation period has expired" }, status: :forbidden
          elsif !user.owner?
            return render json: { error: "Account is cancelled" }, status: :forbidden
          end
        end

        session = current_account.sessions.create!(user: user)

        render json: {
          session: session.api_json,
          user: user.api_json,
          account: current_account.api_json
        }, status: :created
      end

      def destroy
        current_session.destroy!
        head :no_content
      end
    end

cd /app && bin/rails runner '
cases = [
  ["100% discount", "100%", true],
  ["1000 discount", "100%", false],
  ["anything", "%", false],
  ["has % sign", "%", true],
  ["order_1", "order_1", true],
  ["orderX1", "order_1", false],
  ["C:\\Users\\admin\\", "\\", true],
  ["C:\\Users\\admin\\", "Users\\admin\\", true],
  ["no backslash", "\\", false],
  ["literal \\% sequence", "\\%", true],
  ["literal % only", "\\%", false],
  ["RECEIPT #42", "receipt", true],
  ["receipt #42", "RECEIPT", true],
  ["regex [a-z]+ (test)", "[a-z]+ (test)", true]
]

cases.each do |haystack, needle, expected|
  escaped = ActiveRecord::Base.sanitize_sql_like(needle, "\\")
  pattern = "%#{escaped}%"
  sql = ActiveRecord::Base.sanitize_sql_array(["SELECT ?::text ILIKE ? ESCAPE '\''\\\\'\''", haystack, pattern])
  actual = ActiveRecord::Base.connection.select_value(sql)
  raise "Mismatch for #{haystack.inspect} / #{needle.inspect}: got #{actual}, expected #{expected}" unless actual == expected
end
puts "All #{cases.size} SQL ILIKE literal cases passed!"
'

messages.thinking:
**A PostgreSQL Revelation!**

Thank goodness we tested that in `rails runner`! Look at this error message: `PG::InvalidEscapeSequence: ERROR: invalid escape string`. "Escape string must be empty or one character." Oh, I see!

The problem is the modern PostgreSQL behavior! With `standard_conforming_strings = on`, which has been the default for ages now (since 9.1 and definitely on PG 18!), `ESCAPE '\\'` in SQL actually needs **two** backslashes (`\\`), not just one (`\`)! It's so easy to trip up on this!

In this mode, `ILIKE :pattern` implicitly uses `\` as the default one-character escape, or we could explicitly use `ESCAPE '\'`. A single backslash is the escape character in SQL. But when we represent it in Ruby strings, we have to escape the backslash... so `"ESCAPE '\\'"` sends a single backslash, while `"ESCAPE '\\\\'` sends two backslashes to PostgreSQL!

Right, I'm going to test `ESCAPE '\'` (or the default `ILIKE ?`) immediately using `bin/rails runner` to make sure it functions as expected!

arguments.command:
cd /app && bin/rails runner '
cases = [
  ["100% discount", "100%", true],
  ["1000 discount", "100%", false],
  ["anything", "%", false],
  ["has % sign", "%", true],
  ["order_1", "order_1", true],
  ["orderX1", "order_1", false],
  ["C:\\Users\\admin\\", "\\", true],
  ["C:\\Users\\admin\\", "Users\\admin\\", true],
  ["no backslash", "\\", false],
  ["literal \\% sequence", "\\%", true],
  ["literal % only", "\\%", false],
  ["RECEIPT #42", "receipt", true],
  ["receipt #42", "RECEIPT", true],
  ["regex [a-z]+ (test)", "[a-z]+ (test)", true],
  ["single '\'' quote", "'\''", true]
]

cases.each do |haystack, needle, expected|
  escaped = ActiveRecord::Base.sanitize_sql_like(needle, "\\")
  pattern = "%#{escaped}%"
  sql = ActiveRecord::Base.sanitize_sql_array(["SELECT ?::text ILIKE ? ESCAPE ?", haystack, pattern, "\\"])
  actual = ActiveRecord::Base.connection.select_value(sql)
  raise "Mismatch for #{haystack.inspect} / #{needle.inspect}: got #{actual}, expected #{expected}" unless actual == expected
end
puts "All #{cases.size} SQL ILIKE literal cases passed!"
'

require "test_helper"

class TicketPrioritiesAndFiltersTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest

    headers = { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => subdomain }
    headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{token}" if token.present?
    headers
  end

  def extract_token_from_last_email
    mail = ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last
    assert_not_nil mail, "Expected an email to have been sent"
    token = mail.body.decoded[/token=([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/, 1]
    assert token.present?, "Expected token in email body"
    token
  end

  def create_verified_business(name: "Acme", subdomain: "acme", owner_name: "Jo Admin", owner_email: "jo@acme.test", password: "owner-password")
    post "/api/v1/account/create",
      params: {
        account: {
          name: name,
          subdomain: subdomain,
          admin: {
            name: owner_name,
            email: owner_email,
            password: password
          }
        }
      },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created

    token = extract_token_from_last_email
    post "/api/v1/email_verifications/confirm",
      params: { email_verification: { token: token } },
      headers: account_headers(subdomain),
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok

    post "/api/v1/sessions",
      params: { session: { email: owner_email, password: password } },
      headers: account_headers(subdomain),
      as: :json
    assert_response :created

  end

    req_initial = nil

        },

    travel_to Time.utc(2026, 11, 21, 10, 15, 0) do

class Ticket < ApplicationRecord
  STATUSES = %w[open pending solved].freeze
  PRIORITIES = %w[normal high].freeze

  belongs_to :account
  belongs_to :requester, class_name: "User"
  belongs_to :assignee, class_name: "User", optional: true

  has_many :comments, dependent: :delete_all

  normalizes :subject, with: ->(subject) { subject.to_s.strip }

  before_validation :set_default_customer_updated_at, on: :create

  validates :subject, presence: true
  validates :status, presence: true, inclusion: { in: STATUSES }
  validates :priority, presence: true, inclusion: { in: PRIORITIES }
  validates :customer_updated_at, presence: true
  validate :requester_belongs_to_account
  validate :assignee_is_active_staff_of_account

  scope :recent_activity, -> { order(updated_at: :desc, id: :desc) }
  scope :recent_customer_activity, -> { order(customer_updated_at: :desc, id: :desc) }
  scope :matching_query, ->(query) {
    return none if query.include?("\u0000")

    pattern = "%#{sanitize_sql_like(query, "\\")}%"
    where(
      <<~SQL.squish,
        tickets.subject ILIKE :pattern ESCAPE :escape
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM comments
          WHERE comments.ticket_id = tickets.id
            AND comments.account_id = tickets.account_id
            AND comments.public = TRUE
            AND comments.body ILIKE :pattern ESCAPE :escape
        )
      SQL
      pattern: pattern,
      escape: "\\"
    )
  }

  def request_json
    {
      id: id,
      subject: subject,
      status: status,
      requester_id: requester_id,
      created_at: created_at,
      updated_at: customer_updated_at
    }
  end

  def ticket_json
    {
      id: id,
      subject: subject,
      status: status,
      priority: priority,
      requester_id: requester_id,
      requester: {
        id: requester.id,
        name: requester.name,
        email: requester.email
      },
      assignee_id: assignee_id,
      assignee: assignee ? {
        id: assignee.id,
        name: assignee.name
      } : nil,
      created_at: created_at,
      updated_at: updated_at
    }
  end

  private

  def set_default_customer_updated_at
    self.customer_updated_at ||= updated_at || created_at || Time.current
  end

  def requester_belongs_to_account
    return if account_id.nil? || requester.nil? || requester.account_id.nil?
    return if requester.account_id == account_id

    errors.add(:requester, :invalid)
  end

  def assignee_is_active_staff_of_account
    return if assignee_id.nil?
    return if assignee.present? && assignee.account_id == account_id && assignee.active_staff?

    errors.add(:assignee_id, :invalid)
  end
end

    class TicketsController < BaseController
      MAX_BIGINT = (1 << 63) - 1

      before_action :require_account!
      before_action :authenticate_user!
      before_action :ensure_account_active!
      before_action :require_staff!

        filter_errors = {}
        filter_messages = []

        if params.key?(:status) && params[:status].to_s != ""
          status = params[:status].is_a?(String) ? params[:status].strip : nil
          if Ticket::STATUSES.include?(status)
            scope = scope.where(status: status)
          else
            msg = "Status is not included in the list"
            filter_errors[:status] = [ msg ]
            filter_messages << msg
          end
        end

        if params.key?(:priority) && params[:priority].to_s != ""
          priority = params[:priority].is_a?(String) ? params[:priority].strip : nil
          if Ticket::PRIORITIES.include?(priority)
            scope = scope.where(priority: priority)
          else
            msg = "Priority is not included in the list"
            filter_errors[:priority] = [ msg ]
            filter_messages << msg
          end
        end

        if params.key?(:assignee_id) && params[:assignee_id].to_s != ""
          raw_assignee = params[:assignee_id]
          if raw_assignee.is_a?(String) && raw_assignee.strip == "unassigned"
            scope = scope.where(assignee_id: nil)
          else
            assignee_id = parse_non_negative_bigint(raw_assignee)
            if assignee_id
              scope = scope.where(assignee_id: assignee_id)
            else
              msg = "Assignee is invalid"
              filter_errors[:assignee_id] = [ msg ]
              filter_messages << msg
            end
          end
        end

        if params.key?(:requester_id) && params[:requester_id].to_s != ""
          requester_id = parse_non_negative_bigint(params[:requester_id])
          if requester_id
            scope = scope.where(requester_id: requester_id)
          else
            msg = "Requester is invalid"
            filter_errors[:requester_id] = [ msg ]
            filter_messages << msg
          end
        end

        if params.key?(:q) && !params[:q].nil?
          if params[:q].is_a?(String)
            query = params[:q].strip
            scope = scope.matching_query(query) unless query.empty?
          else
            msg = "Query is invalid"
            filter_errors[:q] = [ msg ]
            filter_messages << msg
          end
        end

        if filter_errors.any?
          return render json: {
            error: filter_messages.to_sentence,
            errors: filter_errors
          }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        scope = scope.recent_activity
        records, meta = paginate(scope, includes: %i[requester assignee])

        render json: {
          tickets: records.map(&:ticket_json),
          **meta
        }, status: :ok
      end

      def show
        render json: { ticket: @ticket.ticket_json }, status: :ok
      end

      def comments
        scope = @ticket.comments.chronological
        records, meta = paginate(scope, includes: :author)

        render json: {
          comments: records.map(&:api_json),
          **meta
        }, status: :ok
      end

      def update
        ticket_attrs = require_hash_param(:ticket)
        has_comment = ticket_attrs.key?(:comment)
        has_status = ticket_attrs.key?(:status)
        has_assignee = ticket_attrs.key?(:assignee_id)
        has_priority = ticket_attrs.key?(:priority)

        unless has_comment || has_status || has_assignee || has_priority
          return render json: {
            error: "Comment, status, assignee, or priority is required",
            errors: { base: [ "Comment, status, assignee, or priority is required" ] }
          }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        if has_status
          raw_status = ticket_attrs[:status]
          @ticket.status = raw_status.is_a?(String) ? raw_status : nil
        end

        if has_priority
          raw_priority = ticket_attrs[:priority]
          @ticket.priority = raw_priority.is_a?(String) ? raw_priority : nil
        end

        invalid_assignee_input = false
        if has_assignee
          raw_assignee_id = ticket_attrs[:assignee_id]
          if raw_assignee_id.nil?
            @ticket.assignee = nil
          else
            parsed_assignee_id = parse_non_negative_bigint(raw_assignee_id)
            if parsed_assignee_id
              candidate = current_account.users.find_by(id: parsed_assignee_id)
              if candidate
                @ticket.assignee = candidate
              else
                invalid_assignee_input = true
              end
            else
              invalid_assignee_input = true
            end
          end
        end

        comment = nil
        invalid_comment_envelope = false
        if has_comment
          comment_attrs = ticket_attrs[:comment]
          if comment_attrs.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters) || comment_attrs.is_a?(Hash)
            public_value = if comment_attrs.key?(:public)
              case comment_attrs[:public]
              when true, "true" then true
              when false, "false" then false
              else nil
              end
            else
              true
            end

            raw_body = comment_attrs[:body]
            comment = @ticket.comments.new(
              account: current_account,
              author: current_user,
              body: raw_body.is_a?(String) ? raw_body : nil,
              public: public_value
            )
          else
            invalid_comment_envelope = true
          end
        end

        ticket_valid = @ticket.valid?
        comment_valid = comment ? comment.valid? : !invalid_comment_envelope

        if !ticket_valid || !comment_valid || invalid_assignee_input
          combined_errors = @ticket.errors.to_hash(true)
          all_messages = @ticket.errors.full_messages.dup

          if invalid_assignee_input
            combined_errors[:assignee_id] = [ "Assignee is invalid" ]
            all_messages << "Assignee is invalid"
          end

          if invalid_comment_envelope
            combined_errors[:comment] = [ "Comment can't be blank" ]
            all_messages << "Comment can't be blank"
          elsif comment && !comment_valid
            comment.errors.to_hash(true).each do |field, messages|
              combined_errors[:"comment.#{field}"] = messages
            end
            all_messages.concat(comment.errors.full_messages)
          end

          return render json: {
            error: all_messages.to_sentence,
            errors: combined_errors
          }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        customer_visible_change = (comment.present? && comment.public?) || @ticket.will_save_change_to_status?
        now = Time.current

        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          comment.save! if comment
          @ticket.updated_at = now
          @ticket.customer_updated_at = now if customer_visible_change
          @ticket.save!
        end

        render json: { ticket: @ticket.ticket_json }, status: :ok
      end

      private

      def set_ticket
        @ticket = current_account.tickets.includes(:requester, :assignee).find(params[:id])
      end

      def parse_non_negative_bigint(value)
        id = if value.is_a?(Integer)
          value
        elsif value.is_a?(String)
          stripped = value.strip
          stripped.match?(/\A\d+\z/) ? stripped.to_i : nil
        end

        id if id && id >= 0 && id <= MAX_BIGINT
      end
    end
  end
end

            errors: { base: [ "Comment or status is required" ] }
          }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        combined_errors = {}
        all_messages = []

        if has_status
          raw_status = req_attrs[:status]
          if raw_status.is_a?(String) && raw_status == "solved"
            @ticket.status = "solved"
          else
            combined_errors[:status] = [ "Status is not included in the list" ]
            all_messages << "Status is not included in the list"
          end
        elsif @ticket.status.in?(%w[pending solved])
          @ticket.status = "open"
        end

        comment = nil
        if has_comment
          comment_attrs = req_attrs[:comment]
          if comment_attrs.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters) || comment_attrs.is_a?(Hash)
            raw_body = comment_attrs[:body]
            comment = @ticket.comments.new(
              account: current_account,
              author: current_user,
              body: raw_body.is_a?(String) ? raw_body : nil,
              public: true
            )

            unless comment.valid?
              comment.errors.to_hash(true).each do |field, messages|
                combined_errors[:"comment.#{field}"] = messages
              end
              all_messages.concat(comment.errors.full_messages)
            end
          else
            combined_errors[:comment] = [ "Comment can't be blank" ]
            all_messages << "Comment can't be blank"
          end
        end

        if combined_errors.any?
          return render json: {
            error: all_messages.to_sentence,
            errors: combined_errors
          }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        now = Time.current
        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          comment.save! if comment
          @ticket.updated_at = now
          @ticket.customer_updated_at = now
          @ticket.save!
        end

        render json: { request: @ticket.request_json }, status: :ok
      end

      private

      def set_ticket
        @ticket = current_account.tickets.where(requester_id: current_user.id).find(params[:id])
      end
    end
  end
end

      [ "[urgent] (a|b)", [ t5_id ] ],
      [ "& 'quote' !op", [ t5_id ] ],
      [ "foo\u0000bar", [] ]
    ].each do |literal_q, expected_ids|
      get "/api/v1/tickets", params: { q: literal_q }, headers: account_headers("acme", admin_token)
      assert_response :ok, "Expected 200 OK for q=#{literal_q.inspect}"
      assert_equal expected_ids, response.parsed_body.fetch("tickets").map { |t| t["id"] }, "Mismatch for q=#{literal_q.inspect}"
    end

    # Invalid / malformed filter values return 422
    [
      { status: "closed" },
      { "status[]" => "open" },
      { priority: "urgent" },
      { "priority[]" => "high" },
      { assignee_id: "nobody" },
      { assignee_id: "-1" },
      { assignee_id: "99999999999999999999999999" },
      { "assignee_id[]" => sam.id },
      { requester_id: "unassigned" },
      { requester_id: "invalid" },
      { requester_id: "-5" },
      { requester_id: "99999999999999999999999999" },
      { "requester_id[]" => avery.id },
      { "q[]" => "receipt" }
    ].each do |bad_params|
      get "/api/v1/tickets", params: bad_params, headers: account_headers("acme", admin_token)
      assert_response :unprocessable_entity, "Expected 422 for #{bad_params.inspect}"
    end

    # Multiple invalid filters report all errors
    get "/api/v1/tickets",
      params: { status: "bad", priority: "bad", assignee_id: "bad", requester_id: "bad" },
      headers: account_headers("acme", admin_token)
    assert_response :unprocessable_entity
    errs = response.parsed_body.fetch("errors")
    assert errs.key?("status")
    assert errs.key?("priority")
    assert errs.key?("assignee_id")
    assert errs.key?("requester_id")

    # Cross-tenant isolation on filters and search
    _globex, globex_admin_token = create_verified_business(subdomain: "globex", owner_email: "jo@globex.test")
    _globex_cust, globex_cust_token = register_and_verify_customer(subdomain: "globex", name: "Dana", email: "dana@example.test")

    post "/api/v1/requests",
      params: { request: { subject: "Globex receipt issue", comment: { body: "Globex receipt body" } } },
      headers: account_headers("globex", globex_cust_token),
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    globex_t_id = response.parsed_body.dig("request", "id")
    patch "/api/v1/tickets/#{globex_t_id}",
      params: { ticket: { priority: "high" } },
      headers: account_headers("globex", globex_admin_token),
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok

    get "/api/v1/tickets",
      params: { status: "open", assignee_id: "unassigned", priority: "high", q: "receipt" },
      headers: account_headers("globex", globex_admin_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [ globex_t_id ], response.parsed_body.fetch("tickets").map { |t| t["id"] }

    get "/api/v1/tickets",
      params: { requester_id: avery.id },
      headers: account_headers("globex", globex_admin_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [], response.parsed_body.fetch("tickets")

    # Customer request status filter isolation, pagination, and validation
    get "/api/v1/requests", params: { status: "open" }, headers: account_headers("acme", avery_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [ t4_id, t3_id, t1_id ], response.parsed_body.fetch("requests").map { |r| r["id"] }
    assert_equal 3, response.parsed_body["count"]

    get "/api/v1/requests", params: { status: "open", page: 1, per_page: 2 }, headers: account_headers("acme", avery_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [ t4_id, t3_id ], response.parsed_body.fetch("requests").map { |r| r["id"] }
    assert_equal 3, response.parsed_body["count"]
    assert_equal 2, response.parsed_body["next_page"]

    get "/api/v1/requests", params: { status: "pending" }, headers: account_headers("acme", avery_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [ t5_id ], response.parsed_body.fetch("requests").map { |r| r["id"] }

    get "/api/v1/requests", params: { status: "solved" }, headers: account_headers("acme", avery_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [], response.parsed_body.fetch("requests")

    get "/api/v1/requests", params: { status: "solved" }, headers: account_headers("acme", blair_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [ t6_id ], response.parsed_body.fetch("requests").map { |r| r["id"] }

    get "/api/v1/requests", params: { status: "" }, headers: account_headers("acme", blair_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [ t6_id, t2_id ], response.parsed_body.fetch("requests").map { |r| r["id"] }

    get "/api/v1/requests", params: { status: "invalid" }, headers: account_headers("acme", avery_token)
    assert_response :unprocessable_entity
    assert_equal [ "Status is not included in the list" ], response.parsed_body.dig("errors", "status")

    get "/api/v1/requests", params: { "status[]" => "open" }, headers: account_headers("acme", avery_token)
    assert_response :unprocessable_entity

    # Customer cannot use requester_id param to view another customer's requests
    get "/api/v1/requests", params: { status: "solved", requester_id: blair.id }, headers: account_headers("acme", avery_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [], response.parsed_body.fetch("requests")

    # Cancelled account blocks filtered endpoints too
    post "/api/v1/account/cancel", headers: account_headers("acme", admin_token), as: :json
    assert_response :ok
    acme.reload
    avery_session = acme.sessions.create!(user: avery)
    admin_session = acme.sessions.create!(user: acme.owner)

    get "/api/v1/tickets", params: { priority: "high" }, headers: account_headers("acme", admin_session.token)
    assert_response :forbidden

    get "/api/v1/requests", params: { status: "open" }, headers: account_headers("acme", avery_session.token)
    assert_response :forbidden
  end
end

cd /app && ruby -e '
require "net/http"
require "json"

pid = spawn("bin/rails", "server", "-p", "4010", "-e", "development", out: "/tmp/puma_smoke.log", err: "/tmp/puma_smoke.log")
begin
  30.times do
    res = Net::HTTP.get_response(URI("http://127.0.0.1:4010/up"))
    break if res.code == "200"
  rescue Errno::ECONNREFUSED
    sleep 0.2
  end

  # Setup via runner for quick smoke verification, then clean up
  out = `bin/rails runner '\''
    Account.where(subdomain: "smoketest").destroy_all
    acc = Account.create!(name: "SmokeTest", subdomain: "smoketest")
    admin = acc.users.create!(name: "Admin", email: "admin@smoke.test", password: "password123", role: "admin", verified: true)
    acc.update!(owner: admin)
    cust = acc.users.create!(name: "Cust", email: "cust@smoke.test", password: "password123", role: "customer", verified: true)
    admin_tok = acc.sessions.create!(user: admin).token
    cust_tok = acc.sessions.create!(user: cust).token
    puts JSON.generate(admin_tok: admin_tok, cust_tok: cust_tok, cust_id: cust.id)
  '\''`
  tokens = JSON.parse(out.lines.last)

  uri = URI("http://127.0.0.1:4010/api/v1/requests")
  req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri, "Content-Type" => "application/json", "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "smoketest", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{tokens["cust_tok"]}")
  req.body = JSON.generate(request: { subject: "Receipt 100% needed", comment: { body: "Please send receipt" } })
  res = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port) { |h| h.request(req) }
  raise "Expected 201, got #{res.code}: #{res.body}" unless res.code == "201"
  created_req = JSON.parse(res.body)["request"]
  raise "Priority leaked!" if created_req.key?("priority")
  tid = created_req["id"]

  uri = URI("http://127.0.0.1:4010/api/v1/tickets/#{tid}")
  req = Net::HTTP::Patch.new(uri, "Content-Type" => "application/json", "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "smoketest", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{tokens["admin_tok"]}")
  req.body = JSON.generate(ticket: { priority: "high" })
  res = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port) { |h| h.request(req) }
  raise "Expected 200, got #{res.code}: #{res.body}" unless res.code == "200"
  raise "Expected high priority" unless JSON.parse(res.body).dig("ticket", "priority") == "high"

  uri = URI("http://127.0.0.1:4010/api/v1/tickets?status=open&assignee_id=unassigned&priority=high&q=receipt")
  req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri, "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "smoketest", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{tokens["admin_tok"]}")
  res = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port) { |h| h.request(req) }
  raise "Expected 200, got #{res.code}: #{res.body}" unless res.code == "200"
  raise "Expected [#{tid}]" unless JSON.parse(res.body)["tickets"].map { |t| t["id"] } == [tid]

  puts "Live Puma HTTP smoke test passed!"
ensure
  Process.kill("TERM", pid) rescue nil
  Process.wait(pid) rescue nil
  system("bin/rails runner '\''Account.where(subdomain: \"smoketest\").destroy_all'\''")
  File.delete("/tmp/puma_smoke.log") if File.exist?("/tmp/puma_smoke.log")
end
'

I have implemented internal ticket priorities (`normal` and `high`, defaulting to `normal`), combined inbox filters and literal case-insensitive search for staff, and status filtering for customer requests:

- **Database & Model (`Ticket`)**:
  - Added non-null `priority` column to `tickets` defaulting to `"normal"`, along with composite indexes on `tickets` and `comments` for filtered inbox/request queries and comment search.
  - Added `Ticket::PRIORITIES = %w[normal high]` validation and included `priority` in staff `ticket_json` responses while keeping `request_json` unchanged so priority remains internal.
  - Added `Ticket.matching_query` using `sanitize_sql_like` and `ILIKE ... ESCAPE` across `tickets.subject` and `EXISTS` over public `comments` (`public = TRUE`), treating user input as literal text without row duplication.
- **Staff Tickets API (`Api::V1::TicketsController`)**:
  - Updated `PATCH/PUT /api/v1/tickets/:id` to let staff update `priority` (`normal` or `high`), bumping `updated_at` without changing `customer_updated_at` unless a customer-visible change (public comment or status change) occurs.
  - Updated `GET /api/v1/tickets` to support combinable `status`, `priority`, `assignee_id` (`unassigned` or user ID), `requester_id`, and `q` filters with `422` validation errors for invalid filter parameters.
- **Customer Requests API (`Api::V1::RequestsController`)**:
  - Updated `GET /api/v1/requests` to allow customers to filter their own requests by `status` (`open`, `pending`, `solved`), while keeping priority internal.
